subject: Executive handoff & path to close: timing, owners, escalation
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Ava Byrne <ava.bryne@brightline.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Executive handoff & path to close: timing, owners, escalation

Ava — great to speak earlier. Per our call I wanted to introduce the internal leadership who will partner with Brightline through the evaluation and procurement window, and to propose a simple, time-boxed path to close so we can lock in a Q2 pilot start.

Goal: align exec owners, confirm the MAP (evaluation milestones + responsibilities), and surface an escalation path for any timing or security blockers.

High-level suggested timeline (attached: 2026-02-20_MAP_timeline_v1.xlsx):
- Week 1 (this week): Exec intro + finalize evaluation criteria and success metrics
- Weeks 2–3: Technical evals (test dataset run + performance verification)
- Week 4: Commercial terms & SOW review; legal procurement loop
- Week 5: Exec approval and signatures -> pilot kickoff

Owners (we propose):
- Executive sponsor (commercial): Ava Byrne, Brightline; Marcus Lin, Redwood (exec-to-exec check-ins)
- Technical lead: Laura Bennett (Redwood) / Brightline technical contact (TBD)
- Procurement & contract: Marissa Cole (Redwood) / Brightline procurement
- Escalation path: Rishi Malhotra (Redwood) — see attached SLA-escalation-path.pdf

Action items for today:
1) Ava: confirm the Brightline exec sponsor (VP/CTO level) who will be involved in the final approval step.
2) Brightline procurement: share any mandatory contract clauses or templates we should review.
3) Internal owners: review attached MAP timeline and tell me if the milestones look reasonable or if we should shift any dates.

If we can get a yes on the timeline by Monday, we’ll lock the calendar for the technical window. Happy to set a 30-minute exec alignment call next week if useful — Marcus & Ava only.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
marcus@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0147

Attachment: 2026-02-20_MAP_timeline_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 12KB)
Attachment: SLA-escalation-path.pdf (pdf, 48KB)

From: Ava Byrne <ava.bryne@brightline.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: Brightline - Procurement <procurement@brightline.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 11:03:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Executive handoff & path to close: timing, owners, escalation

Marcus — thanks, this looks clear. I’m looping in our procurement alias and confirming our exec sponsor here: our VP of Engineering, Daniel Ortiz (daniel.ortiz@brightline.ai), will own the final approval. He wants to be briefed only at the sign-off step unless a technical blocker emerges.

Quick answers:
- Procurement: I’ve asked them to provide our standard procurement template by EOD Monday.
- Technical lead: I’ll confirm our staff engineer (for the test dataset run) by Monday afternoon.

We’re aligned on the proposed milestones; one ask: can Redwood guarantee a 72-hour turnaround on performance runs once we hand you the test dataset? That cadence will determine whether we hit week 3 as planned.

Happy to do a Marcus/Ava/Daniel 20-minute sync next Tuesday before the start of the technical window to keep it light.

Best,
Ava Byrne
Head of Partnerships, Brightline AI
ava.bryne@brightline.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Ava Byrne <ava.bryne@brightline.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Feb 2026 08:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Executive handoff & path to close: timing, owners, escalation

All — thanks, I reviewed the timeline and made two small adjustments in the attached spreadsheet to reflect legal review lead times (see row notes). I also added a procurement checklist so Brightline procurement can quickly validate outstanding items.

Marissa notes:
- We can commit to the 72-hour turnaround for standardized perf runs assuming the dataset and access tokens arrive by EOD Monday of the technical window. Any delays there will push the window accordingly.
- For the commercial model, we plan to propose a pilot SOW + option to scale. I’ll circulate a draft SOW by Thursday for Brightline procurement to mark up.

Next steps:
- Ava / Procurement: please send your template and any mandatory clause list by Monday.
- Laura & Brightline tech lead: confirm the dataset delivery plan (S3 presigned link preferred).
- Rishi: I’ve flagged the SLA doc for you to confirm the escalation points.

Marissa Cole
Head of Commercial Operations, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

Attachment: 2026-02-20_MAP_timeline_v1.xlsx (updated with procurement notes)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ava Byrne <ava.bryne@brightline.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 15:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Executive handoff & path to close: timing, owners, escalation

A quick note on escalation and exec engagement cadence.

1) Escalation ladder (summary):
- Day 0–2: Technical owner triage (Laura Bennett)
- Day 3–5: Commercial & delivery lead (Marissa Cole)
- Day 6+: Exec escalation to Rishi (if unresolved) -> Rishi will loop Marcus and then Brightline exec sponsor (Daniel Ortiz) only if we need a final decision.

2) Exec check-ins: recommend two brief checkpoints:
- T-minus 7 days to pilot sign-off: 15-minute alignment (Marcus + Ava + Daniel optional)
- Final sign-off day: 20-minute review with Daniel only if there are open commercial or security items

3) Risk call triggers: security evidence gaps, perf outliers >20% vs target, or contract clause exceptions requested by Brightline procurement.

I’ve attached a short PDF with the escalation contact matrix and SLAs. If everyone is good I’ll publish the MAP timeline as the canonical plan and add it to the HubSpot deal record.

Rishi Malhotra
Director, Customer Reliability, Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.com

Attachment: SLA-escalation-path.pdf (pdf, 48KB)
